name: ibis-office
description: The next-gen Office suite built with Rust & GPUI. Blazing-fast, memory-safe, and highly accurate editing for DOCX, XLSX, and PPTX with pixel-perfect rendering. Powered by DirectX, Metal, Vulkan & WebGPU for peak performance across Windows, macOS, Linux, and Web (Wasm).

paragraphs: The next-generation office suite, built with Rust and the GPU, that opens your documents exactly as Microsoft Office shows them.
Word (.docx), Excel (.xlsx) and PowerPoint (.pptx) — fast, accurate, everywhere.

ibisOffice is an office suite for viewing, editing and saving Word, Excel and PowerPoint documents. It is written entirely in Rust and draws everything on the GPU. The same single codebase runs as a desktop app on macOS, Windows and Linux and in the web browser.
features: Documents (.docx): paragraphs and styles, bullets and numbering, tables, columns, vertical text, ruby and East Asian typography, footnotes and endnotes, headers and footers, fields (page numbers, tables of contents,…

Spreadsheets (.xlsx): over 500 worksheet functions, dynamic arrays and spilling, LET and LAMBDA, structured and 3D references, conditional formatting (data bars, color scales, icon sets), number formats (including…

Presentations (.pptx): slide masters, layouts, themes and variants, custom slide sizes, sections, headers and footers, speaker notes and handouts; shapes (all 187 ECMA-376 preset geometries, boolean merge operations,…
Macro-enabled files (.docm, .xlsm, .pptm) open and save too. Macros are never run; they are kept as they are.
